sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Alpha Route commenced. Standby to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Leaving standby to commence standby outside HQ to show presence.
No issues found; now patrolling down Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence while making quick check-ups along the way.
Fire alarm went off at Nike; standby while continuing to show presence. Spoke with staff — just a fire drill.
Stopped at New Balance and provided our emergency contact details, giving them a quick walkthrough of our services. They were grateful and looking forward to working with us on future issues.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, no issues found.
Arrived at check-in Fort Street; welfare check along all stores within the area and static guard, all clear.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks commenced, all clear.
Response call from the top of Victoria Street, Roma Blooms, reporting a female vagrant sitting at the top of Victoria Street begging for money.
Scoped out lower Queen Street for any issues or concerns, all clear.
Walking through Swanson Street, no issues found.
Patrolling up Albert Street ensuring a strong security presence.

Arrived at the response location; POI known as Vicky is back causing a disturbance, verbally harassing members of the public for money and yelling at and chasing those who do not give her anything. Standby to show presence.
POI Vicky has moved along and is making her way down Victoria Street.
Continuing patrols and showing presence along Victoria Street.
Welfare check along Liquor City Victoria Street, all clear.
Arrived at HQ; standby to recharge the Ops Phone (battery at 14%).
Leaving HQ with the Ops Phone at 27%.
Commencing welfare check along High Street stores and businesses.
Arrived at Freyberg Place, no issues found.
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square; full sweep completed, standby to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols due to no issues or concerns present.
Arrived at check-in bottom of Fort Street; welfare check completed on all stores and businesses within the area, all clear. Standby to show presence.
Continuing patrols and ending Alpha Route. Making our way back to HQ to commence building checks.
Arrived at HQ; commencing building checks.
Floor checks completed. Taking our break before continuing patrols.
Commencing Delta Route. Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting a female vagrant sitting in front of their store, requesting to move the individual along.
Stopped at Ippondo and advised two street vagrants sitting in front of the store to move along and possibly return once closed, due to complaints by store staff.

Arrived at the McDonald's Queen response call; asked the POI sitting in front of their glass window to move to the side away from the front of the store. POI complied without further issues. Standby to show presence before moving along. Now making our way to grab our vehicles before getting a parking ticket.
Arrived at HQ to commence break.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart reporting a group of vagrants blasting music loudly and vaping inside the store.

Arrived at the response location; asked the group of POI to move along due to causing a disturbance inside the store. One vagrant wasn't complying and started a verbal altercation until we pestered them to move along.

After his group of friends acknowledged what they did with vaping inside and swearing at customers, they told the POI trying to have a verbal altercation that he was in the wrong and to just leave it and move along.
Response call from Strand Arcade reporting an aggressive vagrant destroying store belongings and property; immediate assistance requested.

Arrived at the response location, Strand Arcade; asked the group of vagrants (a group of minors) to get up and move along due to shuffling tables and chairs around. They got up immediately and moved along; advised them to stop being a nuisance to stores and businesses. The store owner was thankful for our assistance and said he will contact the building manager to retrieve video footage of the group causing a disturbance inside Strand Arcade. (Video on file.)
Continuing to move along and making our way to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square; full sweep completed, all clear. Standby for response calls and showing presence.
Continuing patrols to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check along Rutland Street, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Elliott Street apartment, all clear. Commencing welfare check inside Elliott Stables and Atrium on Elliott, all clear.
Heard yelling coming from Queen Street; heading over to check it out.

Elderly Caucasian male under the influence of alcohol and showing strong signs of intoxication; advised the POI to grab something to eat and drink some water. He complied and went to Avachi to grab something to eat. POI had been harassing members of the public sitting in front of Banh Mi.
Arrived at HQ to recharge the Ops Phone again due to low battery (13%). Standby for response calls and incidents.
Leaving HQ and continuing patrols. Ending Delta Route and commencing Bravo Route. Ops Phone at 32%.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queen, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City shopping centre, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square; standby to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Arrived at check-in top of Victoria Street; welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at Queen Street; taking our lunch break.
Arrived at HQ; preparing for changeover.
Afternoon Shift completed. Equipment handover: 2 x Vest, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycamera, Ops Phone, 5 x sets of keys, 2 x Swipe Cards.
